resources.string: For review, 19 October 2026. These texts are not final. Contact details and some procedures are still being prepared. Reading them does not record agreement or submit a request.
Using Red Square, your wallet and shared content.

Red Square is an Android app for Saito social posts and Chat. Angels’ Foundry is the selected app publisher. The first release is planned as a free community app. You choose between saito.davidengelen.nl and saito.io. Available history and moderation can differ between nodes.

The app creates or imports a wallet on your device. Keep an authenticated backup somewhere you control. Losing the wallet or its backup can mean losing access to your identity and funds. Transfers require confirmation and device authentication. This app does not promise returns, recover lost keys or undo confirmed network transfers.

Only share content you are entitled to share. The proposed Community guidelines prohibit abusive and illegal content. Public posts and group messages can be copied by others. Private Chat encrypts message content, but routing information is not made anonymous and complete history recovery is not guaranteed.
Registered publisher details, support contacts, eligibility, final terms and their acceptance process are still being prepared. This draft does not activate new restrictions or record consent.
What stays on your phone and what reaches other services.

Private wallet material, drafts and Chat history are stored using Android Keystore encryption. Public feed caches, public content references and some preferences are stored locally without that encryption. When publishing agreement is required, its accepted revision is also kept locally without that encryption, across wallets and nodes on this installation. It is outside wallet exports and is not uploaded as a separate agreement record. Android automatic app backup is disabled. Exporting a wallet writes sensitive private material to the document location you choose, which may be a cloud provider. Never send a wallet backup to support.

The selected node receives connections, requests, your public wallet identity and signatures. Posts, profile updates and related signed actions can become public. Group Chat messages are unencrypted. Private Chat encrypts message content, while public sender and recipient routing details remain visible. Independent servers and recipients may retain copies.

Remote images contact their hosts. Opening YouTube playback contacts YouTube. Configured GIF search contacts Giphy and loading GIF media contacts its delivery services. Configured background notifications use Firebase and a gateway after a separate notification choice; Android permission alone is not that choice. These services are not all configured in the current preview. Extensive usage tracking is not planned, and no extra crash-reporting service has been selected.

The final privacy contact, purposes and provider roles, retention schedule, request rights and operational procedures are still being prepared. No automatic server-deletion deadline or complete erasure of network copies is promised by this draft.
Proposed conduct rules, reports and personal controls.

Do not publish or send threats, targeted harassment, hateful abuse, fraud, unlawful private information or content that violates another person’s rights. Do not share child sexual abuse material, exploit children, groom them or solicit sexual content from them. Do not use the app for illegal activity or distribute sexually explicit content. These proposed rules cover posts, profiles, shared media and Chat.

Account mute hides posts and notifications while keeping Chat accessible. Account block also hides incoming Chat messages from that account. Conversation mute silences alerts while keeping the conversation visible. Personal controls apply to the active wallet on this device across both supported nodes; they do not delete other people’s copies.

Use Report on a post and check the destination shown before sending. Reports go to the currently selected node. An acknowledgement confirms receipt, not review or removal. The two nodes can apply different moderation decisions. App-publisher complaints need their own working contact route.

Angels’ Foundry has accepted responsibility for its own backend moderation and app-publisher messages. Actual contact channels, review, escalation and enforcement procedures, plus complete user-report coverage, remain unfinished. This draft does not claim continuous moderation is already operational.
Proposed standards against child abuse and exploitation.

Red Square must not be used for child sexual abuse or exploitation. The proposed standards prohibit abuse material, grooming, sexual solicitation, sextortion and trafficking involving children. Do not repost harmful material when reporting it.

Existing post reports name the selected node before submission. A receipt does not prove safety review or action. The app-publisher feedback route and dedicated safety contact are still being prepared. If someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

The responsible public contact, effective handling and appropriate escalation process, published standards and store declaration must be completed before release. No safety report is sent from this reader.
Wallet safety, retained copies and the planned request process.

A wallet controls your Saito identity and funds. Uninstalling, clearing storage or losing device keys can make local data inaccessible. Export and verify a backup before destructive actions. Replacing a wallet is not account deletion. This screen does not clear data or destroy keys.

Deleting a post removes it from normal app views when the action is verified; historical records, independent archives and recipient copies can remain. Leaving a group, blocking someone or disabling notifications does not erase shared messages. Available Chat history is not promised forever, and wallet import alone does not guarantee complete recovery.

The intended request process must identify publisher-held data, verify authority without collecting private wallet material, explain retained records and report completed and failed actions. Independent operators cannot be promised to erase copies. You will need a working request route outside the app as well as an in-app entry point.

The request contact and web address, verification method, completion process and justified retention schedule are not finalized. No request can be submitted here yet. A future deletion flow must preserve backup, authentication and transfer safeguards before any local removal.
The selected publisher and contact channels still to be completed.

Angels’ Foundry is the selected publisher of Red Square. Business registration was confirmed as not yet complete on 19 October 2026. This name does not indicate a verified Google Play organization account.

Support never needs your private wallet, seed, signing key or backup file. When asking about an issue, use the public app version and describe what happened. Check screenshots for private information before sharing them.

Public support, privacy/deletion and child-safety contact details are being prepared. There is no active email address or request link in this preview. Existing post reports still go to the selected node; they are separate from contacting the app publisher.
